'''Per Michael Johansen''' (born 1960) is a Danish [[engineer]] and [[physicist]] and the current [[Rector (academia)|rector]] of [[Aalborg University]] (AAU).

== Early life ==

Johansen was born in 1960 in the small holiday and fishing village Agger in the [[Thy (district)|Thy]] district, which is located in the northwestern part of [[Jutland]] in [[Denmark]]. He graduated from high school in [[Thisted]] in 1980.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.inside.aau.dk/nyheder/vis-alle-nyheder/rektor-bliver-foerste-aeresstudent-fra-thisted-gymnasium.cid176071/|title=REKTOR BLIVER FØRSTE ÆRESSTUDENT FRA THISTED GYMNASIUM|date=20 March 2015|publisher=[[Aalborg University]]|accessdate=24 June 2019|language=Danish}}</ref> He subsequently studied Technical Physics (Engineering) at [[Aalborg University]] and holds a master's degree within this particular field which he was awarded in 1986. In addition to his master's degree he also holds a [[PhD]] (awarded in 1989) and a title of [[Doctor of Science]] in [[physics]] (awarded in 2001).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.altinget.dk/person/per-michael-johansen/|title=Per Michael Johansen|date=31 July 2018|publisher=[[Altinget]]|accessdate=24 June 2019|language=Danish}}</ref>

== Academic career == 

After graduating his PhD, Johansen first worked at [[Aalborg University]] (AAU) for a short period at the Department of Physics. Later, he was employed as a researcher at [[Risø DTU National Laboratory for Sustainable Energy]] for a number of years. In 2005, he became Director of Svendborg International Maritime Academy. After his job as director, he became the [[Dean (education)|Dean]] of the Faculty of Engineering at the [[University of Southern Denmark]] for seven years. In 2014, he took over the title and job as rector at Aalborg University (AAU) from his predecessor [[Finn Kjærsdam]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.aau.dk/nyheder/alle-nyheder/vis/ny-rektor-for-aalborg-universitet.cid94022/|title=Nyheder fra Aalborg Universitet|date=16 December 2013|publisher=[[Aalborg University]]|accessdate=24 January 2016|language=Danish|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160129051802/http://www.aau.dk/nyheder/alle-nyheder/vis/ny-rektor-for-aalborg-universitet.cid94022/|archive-date=29 January 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>
